Name: let-counter
Intended: assignment to an immutable let binding

Name: private-group
Intended: access to a group that is no longer public

Name: overload-parameter-type
Intended: no overload accepts the argument type; the closure body also compares bool with i32

Name: overload-length
Intended: no overload accepts the array length

Name: bare-generic-transfer
After:
let copied: T = values[index]
            result = result + forward<T>(values[index]@ref/T)
Intended: a bare generic Place is moved without @move

Name: missing-capture
Intended: a runtime binding crosses a function boundary without a capture

Name: wrong-follow-target
Intended: an exclusive borrow names another Type

Name: missing-operand
Intended: a binary operator without its right operand; the assignment it feeds is not checked again

Name: chained-comparison
Intended: an ungrouped comparison chain; the recovered condition is not type-checked

Name: unclosed-call
Intended: a call whose argument list is not closed before the indentation returns

Name: misspelled-type
Intended: an unknown Type; the uses of the variable rest on it

Name: independent-errors
After:
Console.writeLne("Sum is 55.")
    let wrong: i32 = true
Intended: two unrelated errors in one edit: both are reported

Name: symbolic-and
Intended: '&&' for logical conjunction in a require condition; the failure body the recovery supplies is not checked for fallthrough

Name: header-stray-token
Intended: a stray token at the end of a while header; the indented body that follows is still the loop's

Name: missing-return
Intended: the final value is written without return, so the Block body falls through; the result it leaves undelivered is not reported again

Name: string-plus
Intended: two strings joined with + instead of one interpolated literal (SPEC 13.3)

Name: float-shift
Intended: the float is shifted instead of its bits; the conversion of the rejected shift is not checked again (SPEC 13.3)
